lines.text: How long to the nearest star? Say we leave today.
lines.phonemes: hˌaʊ lˈɔŋ tə ðə nˌɪɹɪst stˈɑːɹ? sˈeɪ wiː lˈiːv tədˈeɪ.

lines.text: Our ride is Voyager 1, the farthest thing we've sent. It left in nineteen seventy-seven. It coasts at about seventeen kilometers a second. Earth to the Moon in six hours.
lines.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ ɹˈaɪd ɪz vˈɔɪɪdʒɚ wˈʌn, ðə fˈɑːɹðɪst θˈɪŋ wiːv sˈɛnt. ɪt lˈɛft ɪn nˈaɪntiːn sˈɛvəntisˈɛvən. ɪt kˈoʊsts æɾ ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvəntˌiːn kˈɪləmˌiːɾɚz ɐ sˈɛkənd. ˈɜːθ tə ðə mˈuːn ɪn sˈɪks ˈaʊɚz.

lines.text: On November eighteenth, it crosses a line. Its signal now needs a full day to reach us. The team sends a command today. The answer comes the day after tomorrow.
lines.phonemes: ˌɔn noʊvˈɛmbɚɹ ˈeɪtiːnθ, ɪt kɹˈɔsᵻz ɐ lˈaɪn. ɪts sˈɪɡnəl nˈaʊ nˈiːdz ɐ fˈʊl dˈeɪ tə ɹˈiːtʃ ˌʌs. ðə tˈiːm sˈɛndz ɐ kəmˈænd tədˈeɪ. ðɪ ˈænsɚ kˈʌmz ðə dˈeɪ ˈæftɚ təmˈɑːɹoʊ.

lines.text: In twenty twelve, it crossed into interstellar space. Nearly there, then? It hasn't even reached the Sun's cloud of comets. That's about three hundred years away. Through it: maybe thirty thousand more.
lines.phonemes: ɪn twˈɛnti twˈɛlv, ɪt kɹˈɔst ˌɪntʊ ˌɪntɚstˈɛlɚ spˈeɪs. nˌɪɹli ðˈɛɹ, ðˈɛn? ɪt hˈæzənt ˈiːvən ɹˈiːtʃt ðə sˈʌnz klˈaʊd ʌv kˈɑːmɪts. ðæts ɐbˌaʊt θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd jˈɪɹz ɐwˈeɪ. θɹˈuː ɪt: mˈeɪbiː θˈɜːɾi θˈaʊzənd mˈɔːɹ.

lines.text: The nearest star, Proxima Centauri, is about fifteen hundred light-days out. At Voyager's speed: about seventy-five thousand years. Count back that far, and our species wasn't in Europe.
lines.phonemes: ðə nˌɪɹɪst stˈɑːɹ, pɹˈɑːksɪmə sɛntˈɔːɹi, ɪz ɐbˌaʊt fˈɪftiːn hˈʌndɹɪd lˈaɪtdˈeɪz ˈaʊt. æt vˈɔɪɪdʒɚz spˈiːd: ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvəntifˈaɪv θˈaʊzənd jˈɪɹz. kˈaʊnt bˈæk ðæt fˈɑːɹ, ænd ˌaʊɚ spˈiːsiːz wˈʌznt ɪn jˈʊɹɹəp.

lines.text: So we've barely left for the stars. Voyager has crossed day one of fifteen hundred.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ wiːv bˈɛɹli lˈɛft fɚðə stˈɑːɹz. vˈɔɪɪdʒɚ hɐz kɹˈɔst dˈeɪ wˈʌn ʌv fˈɪftiːn hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: Light time, Earth to Voyager: one day. To Proxima Centauri: four years and three months.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt tˈaɪm, ˈɜːθ tə vˈɔɪɪdʒɚ: wˈʌn dˈeɪ. tə pɹˈɑːksɪmə sɛntˈɔːɹi: fˈɔːɹ jˈɪɹz ænd θɹˈiː mˈʌnθs.

lines.text: Next: a world that turns slower than it orbits. And backwards.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ɐ wˈɜːld ðæt tˈɜːnz slˈoʊɚ ðɐn ɪɾ ˈɔːɹbɪts. ænd bˈækwɚdz.
